card.name: Trademark symbols after product names
card.fires_on: The broken-up trademark symbol (™) right after a brand or device name, and the words 'registered' or 'are' in trademark footnotes. It appears in drug-label text naming devices, bags, nebulizers and brand products.

modes.description: The words 'registered' or 'are' in a note saying brands are registered trademarks.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word 'trade' as in 'trademark', and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a brand name is followed by a trademark symbol or a 'registered trademark' note.
